matches.rationale: No report finding covers the missing 128-byte account storage overhead in the minimum-deposit rent calculation.
Finding 7 identifies that deposit and withdraw take a user-supplied bump and store it without checking it against Anchor's canonical bump.
No report finding covers MessageSent emitting the Ethereum chain id as the destination.
No report finding covers msg! log truncation.
Finding 3 identifies that sendMessage stores the generated nonce in sendNonces without first checking it is unused, so collisions are possible.
No report finding says addressArrayInitialized accepts an empty array.
No report finding covers relayer custody of all bridged funds. Finding 4 mentions a compromised relayer, but its defect is the unvalidated deposit amount.
No report finding covers the missing _disableInitializers call in the implementation constructors.
No report finding covers invoke_signed being used where invoke would do.
Finding 6 identifies the hardcoded 1024-byte sizes for WithdrawalReceipt and Configuration.
